mapper.select: select id, ledger_no, remittance_no, account_id, direction, currency, amount, balance_after, create_time, update_time from cross_border_account_ledger where ledger_no = #{ledgerNo}

select id, ledger_no, remittance_no, account_id, direction, currency, amount, balance_after, create_time, update_time from cross_border_account_ledger where remittance_no = #{remittanceNo} order by id asc
mapper.insert: insert into cross_border_account_ledger (ledger_no, remittance_no, account_id, direction, currency, amount, balance_after) values (#{ledgerNo}, #{remittanceNo}, #{accountId}, #{direction}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter})
